name: Aoi Suzuka
source: The protagonist's other childhood friend. She competes with Yui as a love rival for the protagonist, but despite that the relationship between the three of them are still very good. A very mischievous girl, she likes teasing the protagonist. When she comes to with an unexpected situation, she will lose her cool very quickly.
